name: lib_fib_add_mul_period_modEq
statement: (N m : ℕ) (h0 : Nat.fib m ≡ 0 [MOD N]) (h1 : Nat.fib (m + 1) ≡ 1 [MOD N]) (k i : ℕ) : Nat.fib (i + m * k) ≡ Nat.fib i [MOD N]
closed: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (h0 : Nat.fib m ≡ 0 [MOD N]) (h1 : Nat.fib (m + 1) ≡ 1 [MOD N]) (k i : ℕ), Nat.fib (i + m * k) ≡ Nat.fib i [MOD N]
informal: Fibonacci period criterion: if F_m ≡ 0 and F_(m+1) ≡ 1 (mod N) then m (and every multiple m*k) is a period of the Fibonacci sequence mod N: F_(i+m*k) ≡ F_i. Promoted from Mathlib2.p3_aux_period_aux3 (and p3_aux_period_aux2, the case k = 1).
type: ∀ (N m : ℕ), Nat.fib m ≡ 0 [MOD N] → Nat.fib (m + 1) ≡ 1 [MOD N] → ∀ (k i : ℕ), Nat.fib (i + m * k) ≡ Nat.fib i [MOD N]
known_as: p3_aux_period_aux3 N m h0 h1 k i
